计算曲线积分：

参数方程为  
\[
x=\sqrt3\cos t,\quad y=\sqrt3\sin t,\quad z=\frac23 t^{3/2},\quad 0\le t\le5.
\]

先求弧长微元：
\[
x'=-\sqrt3\sin t,\quad y'=\sqrt3\cos t,\quad z'=t^{1/2}.
\]
因此
\[
ds=\sqrt{(x')^2+(y')^2+(z')^2}\,dt
=\sqrt{3\sin^2t+3\cos^2t+t}\,dt
=\sqrt{3+t}\,dt.
\]

又因为
\[
x^2+y^2=3,
\]
所以
\[
\int_C(x^2+y^2)\,ds
=3\int_0^5\sqrt{t+3}\,dt.
\]

计算积分：
\[
3\int_0^5\sqrt{t+3}\,dt
=3\cdot \frac23 (t+3)^{3/2}\Big|_0^5
=2\left(8^{3/2}-3^{3/2}\right).
\]

化简：
\[
8^{3/2}=16\sqrt2,\quad 3^{3/2}=3\sqrt3,
\]
所以
\[
\int_C(x^2+y^2)\,ds
=2\left(16\sqrt2-3\sqrt3\right).
\]

答案：B
